policy: Grid Watch v2 public data layers are restricted to explicitly open-licensed or public-domain data. Proprietary directories, trade-press datasets and unlicensed scraped records are not ingested.
note: The previous hand-curated entries are intentionally not carried into this strict-open-data branch because their source pages are not themselves open-data datasets. Sites remain discoverable through the ODbL OpenStreetMap layer and OGL planning layers; open-licensed evidence can later promote a record into this verified register.
